ingredients.title: Chicken
items: 1 package (15 oz) chicken breast tenders (not breaded)
2 tsp cornstarch
1/2 tsp salt
1/4 tsp white pepper

ingredients.title: Broccoli
items: 1 lb broccoli

ingredients.title: Stir-fry
items: 3 Tbsp chili or vegetable oil
1 tsp dried red pepper flakes
2 Tbsp brown bean sauce or soy sauce
2 tsp finely chopped garlic
1 tsp sugar
1 tsp finely chopped gingerroot
1 package (8 oz) mushrooms, sautéed
3 green onions, cut diagonally into 1-inch pieces

instructions.title: Chicken
items: Mix chicken, cornstarch, salt and white pepper in medium bowl. Cover and refrigerate 20 minutes.

instructions.title: Broccoli
items: Peel outer layer from broccoli. Cut broccoli lengthwise into 1-inch stems; remove flowerets. Cut stems diagonally into 1/4-inch slices.
Place broccoli flowerets and stems in boiling water; heat to boiling. Cover and cook 1 minute; drain. Immediately rinse with cold water; drain.

instructions.title: Stir-fry
items: Heat wok or 12-inch skillet over high heat. Add oil; rotate wok to coat side.
Add chili, brown bean sauce, garlic, sugar and gingerroot; stir-fry 10 seconds.
Add chicken; stir-fry about 2 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink in center.
Add broccoli, mushrooms, and onions; stir-fry about 1 minute or until broccoli is heated through.
